articles.title: Macron condemns racist terrorist attack in Paris suburb
articles.description: Adding to the tensions, France is reeling from a shooting that authorities are investigating as a potentially racist and Islamophobic terrorist attack. One person was killed and five others wounded in the Paris suburbs of Trappes and La Verrière, including a 12-year-old girl who was shot eight times. Police arrested the suspected gunman, and investigators reportedly found three gas cylinders rigged to a timer in his apartment, as well as a submachine gun in his car. The French president has condemned the attack, while the mayor of Saint-Denis has denounced the impact of hate speech.

articles.title: Yemen’s Prime Minister Condemns Terrorist Attack on Church in Jordan
articles.description: ADEN-SABA Prime Minister Dr. Shaya Zindani has extended his sincere condolences to Jordan’s King, government and people over the victims of the terrorist attack on a church in Karak Governorate, wishing the injured a speedy recovery. In a post on X, Dr. Zindani said that targeting places of worship is a horrific crime that undermines the values of coexistence and tolerance and highlights the danger of terrorism as a cross-border threat requiring a unified and firm Arab and international response to protect the security and stability of societies. He stressed that the Yemeni government, which faces the same terrorist approach targeting civilians and innocent people, stands in full solidarity with Jordan and supports its efforts to combat terrorism and extremism, as well as all joint efforts to curb the capabilities of terrorist groups and cut off their sources of support.
